nl: 招聘管理：查询有职位名称、所属部门；表格展示职位名称、所属部门、招聘人数、状态、发布日期；表格上方左侧「新建职位」、右侧「导出」；新增和编辑使用不同的弹窗——新增填职位名称、所属部门、招聘人数，编辑在此基础上还能修改状态；支持新增、编辑、删除；新增、编辑、删除按钮分别需要权限码 recruit:add、recruit:edit、recruit:remove；界面要求国际化；查询表单分 2 列。
nlEn: Recruitment management: query by job title and department; the table shows job title, department, headcount, status, and publish date; above the table "New Job" is on the left and "Export" on the right; add and edit use different dialogs — on add fill in job title, department, and headcount, and on edit you can additionally change the status; supports add, edit, and delete; the add, edit, and delete buttons require permission codes recruit:add, recruit:edit, recruit:remove respectively; the UI requires i18n; the query form is 2 columns.
notes: 五维覆盖：i18n + formLayout(span) + tableBtns(position→code 归一) + dialogs(新增/编辑不同表单) + permissions。schema 模式下顶层 permissions 对渲染 inert（仅进 summary 行）；按钮级门控实际走 tableBtns[].permissionValue。
